name: acquire_spectral
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
lane=Path.cwd();p=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/1806.03593',routes=['339479'],destination='sources/spectral.pdf',source_identity='Hayat Koolen Riaz A spectral characterization of s-clique extension square grids',purpose='Check source hypotheses against join-of-pentagons route ID339479')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'get-spectral.json'],input=json.dumps(p),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'source_get_guard.py'),str(lane/'get-spectral.json')],check=True)
